purpose: Teach: コマース/押し出し/平米/弐/作製/一任/隔週/通りかかっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、Eコマース関連の論文も読め
lines.en: Ren, read the e-commerce papers too.
lines.style: Curt, direct. Matter-of-fact delivery. No inflection at the end — this is instruction, not question. Efficient breath control, steady pace. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会発表の押し出しを意識します
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep the presentation momentum in mind.
lines.style: Eager but controlled. Slight bow in the voice. Measured pace — he's thinking as he speaks. Soft attack on the opening syllable, showing deference without stammering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の平米数を測れ
lines.en: Ren, measure the lab's square footage.
lines.style: Same level directness as before. Clipped phrasing. No warmth, no coldness — purely functional. The unadorned voice of authority making a task assignment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文に「弐千年」を「2000年」と表記統一しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already standardized the year format in the paper to "2000" instead of the old notation.
lines.style: Slightly eager — he's offering proof of work already done. Quiet pride underneath. Careful articulation. Finishes with a downward inflection showing he's done speaking, waiting for the next instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究ポスターの作製を急げ
lines.en: Ren, speed up the research poster production.
lines.style: Quick, sharp attack. Slight edge of urgency in the pace. No preamble, no gentleness. The voice cutting through to the essential task. Hiroshi's impatience is subtle but present.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データ分析は専門の助手に一任しました
lines.en: Yes. I've delegated the data analysis to the specialist assistant.
lines.style: Reporting efficiently, showing he understands delegation and has acted on it. Calm, methodical tone. No hesitation — he's demonstrating competence and reliability. Slight uptick at the end, signaling readiness for the next task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、ゼミは隔週で運営しろ
lines.en: Ren, run the seminar on a biweekly schedule.
lines.style: Final instruction in the series. Same commanding tone, but perhaps fractionally less intense — a routine directive rather than urgent. Clear and unambiguous. Hiroshi's authority is established and doesn't need reinforcement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会会場で偉い先生が通りかかった時、ご挨拶しました
lines.en: Yes. I greeted a senior professor at the conference when he passed by our booth.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the voice — he did something right without being told. Careful, respectful delivery. Slightly longer phrasing showing this was a moment he noticed and handled. Gentle fadeout at the end, inviting Hiroshi's acknowledgment without demanding it.
